<p>Stratum builds AI agents that clear the U.S. government's backlog. A reviewer drops in an application, picks the rubric to check it against, and an agent plans, executes, and reviews the file end to end. Hundreds run in parallel with a human approving every decision, so a backlog that used to take months clears in the time it took to review one file.</p>
<p><strong>The Problem</strong></p>
<p>Every permit, license, patent, drug approval, grants and benefits claim in America has to be reviewed by a government adjudicator, on software built decades before AI. The result is millions of applications stuck in queues, and real people waiting months or years: veterans on disability ratings, families on pensions, builders on permits. The approval isn't the problem. The software it runs on is.</p>
<p><strong>How Stratum Works</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>A reviewer drops in an application and selects the rubric it needs to be checked against.</li>
<li>An agent reads every page and checks the file against that rubric.</li>
<li>Every step routes to the model that reviews it most accurately for the least cost.</li>
<li>Anything missing goes back to the applicant as one specific request.</li>
<li>The officer gets the whole file summarized, with every citation behind it, and approves or denies it.</li>
</ol>
<p>Hundreds of these run in parallel in the cloud, with full auditability at every step, and a person always makes the final call.</p>

<p><strong>The Vision</strong></p>
<p>In a couple of years, dealing with the government should feel as frictionless as booking an Uber or paying with Apple Pay. You tell your Stratum agent what you need, a permit, a license, a claim, and it fills out the application and submits it. On the other side, the government's Stratum agents review it, ask your agent for anything missing, and settle it between themselves. The decision comes back the same day, in minutes. No waiting weeks or months. Clearing today's backlog is only the beginning.</p>

If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?</h4><div><p>In a couple of years, dealing with the government should feel as frictionless as booking an Uber or paying with Apple Pay. You'll have your own set of Stratum agents, and the government will have theirs.</p>
<p>If you need a permit, a licence, or a claim, you just tell your Stratum agent what you need. It handles the rest. It knows everything about you, your situation, what you need, and why, so it fills out the application and sends it to the government. On the other side, the government's Stratum agents read and review the whole thing. If they need anything else, they come back to your agent and ask, and the two of them settle it between themselves. The government makes the call, approval or rejection, and it comes back to you the same day, in a couple of minutes. No waiting days, weeks, or months.</p>
<p>That's the future we're building. The best process is no process. Right now you don't even notice the pain, the hours spent filling out applications, figuring out what goes where, hunting down information. In the future that all disappears. Your Stratum agent knows everything about you, everything about your situation, and everything the government needs, and all of it is built by Stratum.</p>
